sections.title: Bugs
sections.note: Catch one of each with the Bug Net, or by rolling into the tree it's on. Bertie infuses them into potions.

items.name: Skyloft Mantis
items.howTo: On trees around Skyloft. Easy to catch.
items.notes: Used in Revitalizing Potion+ (2) and Air Potion+ (2): 4 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 10 Rupees. HD: its description only appears the first time you pick one up; on Wii it appears again after every reload.

items.name: Sky Stag Beetle
items.howTo: On trees around Skyloft: roll into the trunk to knock it down.
items.notes: Used in Stamina Potion+ (2) and Air Potion+ (2): 4 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 20 Rupees.

items.name: Starry Firefly
items.howTo: Skyloft at night, the Waterfall Cave, Pumpkin Landing and Beedle's Island at night.
items.notes: Used in Guardian Potion+ (3): 3 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 30 Rupees.

items.name: Blessed Butterfly
items.howTo: Everywhere in the Sky and on the Surface; they gather where a Goddess Wall or a harp spot is.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion+ (3), Heart Potion++ (3) and Guardian Potion+ (3): 9 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 5 Rupees.

items.name: Woodland Rhino Beetle
items.howTo: On tree trunks in Faron Woods and the Deep Woods: roll into the tree to knock it down. Slow and easy to catch.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion+ (1), Revitalizing Potion+ (2) and Revitalizing Potion++ (2): 5 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 20 Rupees.

items.name: Deku Hornet
items.howTo: Around the hornet nests of the Deep Woods; knock a nest down and catch the swarm. Bug Rock in the Thunderhead has them too.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion++ (3) and Revitalizing Potion+ (3): 6 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 1 Rupee.

items.name: Faron Grasshopper
items.howTo: In the grass of Faron Woods, the Deep Woods and the Sealed Grounds. It leaps away: creep up slowly.
items.notes: Used in Stamina Potion+ (1) and Guardian Potion+ (1): 2 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 40 Rupees.

items.name: Volcanic Ladybug
items.howTo: In groups on Eldin Volcano. Barely moves.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion+ (1) and Stamina Potion+ (3): 4 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 20 Rupees.

items.name: Eldin Roller
items.howTo: Rare on Eldin Volcano, rolling a ball along the ground.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion++ (1) and Guardian Potion+ (2): 3 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 40 Rupees.

items.name: Lanayru Ant
items.howTo: In swarms at the Lanayru Mine, in Lanayru Desert and at the Temple of Time.
items.notes: Used in Revitalizing Potion++ (3) and Air Potion+ (2): 5 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 20 Rupees.

items.name: Gerudo Dragonfly
items.howTo: In Lanayru Desert. It flies far once disturbed: creep up on it.
items.notes: Used in Revitalizing Potion++ (1) and Stamina Potion+ (2): 3 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 30 Rupees.

items.name: Sand Cicada
items.howTo: On trees and walls in Lanayru Desert, and on Skipper's Retreat. The hardest bug to catch: it flies off quickly.
items.notes: Used in Heart Potion++ (1) and Revitalizing Potion++ (1): 2 in all. Strich buys it on Bug Rock for 50 Rupees.

sections.title: Treasures
sections.note: Find one of each. Gondo turns them into upgrades; Rupin buys them at night.

items.name: Amber Relic
items.howTo: Everywhere: lying around the Surface, in pots and in chests.
items.notes: Used in Tough Beetle (4), Scattershot (2), Medium Quiver (5), Medium Seed Satchel (4), Large Seed Satchel (5), Banded Shield (2) and Braced Shield (3): 25 in all. HD: its description only appears the first time you pick one up; on Wii it appears again after every reload.

items.name: Hornet Larvae
items.howTo: Knock down a Deku Hornet nest (roll into its tree, or hit it with the Slingshot or Beetle) and pick them up.
items.notes: Used in Quick Beetle (2) and Large Bomb Bag (2): 4 in all.

items.name: Jelly Blob
items.howTo: Dropped by Deku Babas, ChuChus and Arachas.
items.notes: Used in Scattershot (3), Large Bomb Bag (4) and Banded Shield (1): 8 in all.

items.name: Bird Feather
items.howTo: Catch a Chirri, the little birds of Faron Woods and the Sealed Grounds, with the Bug Net.
items.notes: Used in Divine Shield (2) and Goddess Shield (3): 5 in all.

items.name: Blue Bird Feather
items.howTo: Catch a rare blue Chirri in Faron Woods or the Sealed Grounds with the Bug Net. The Moonlight Merchant sells them late in the game.
items.notes: Used in Tough Beetle (1), Medium Bomb Bag (1), Large Seed Satchel (1), Fortified Shield (1) and Goddess Shield (1): 5 in all.

items.name: Monster Claw
items.howTo: Dropped by Keese, Walltulas and Guays.
items.notes: Used in Iron Bow (3), Medium Seed Satchel (3), Large Seed Satchel (3), Banded Shield (1), Braced Shield (2), Reinforced Shield (2) and Fortified Shield (3): 17 in all.

items.name: Ornamental Skull
items.howTo: Dropped by Bokoblins, or whip it off one.
items.notes: Used in Medium Bomb Bag (3), Medium Seed Satchel (3), Braced Shield (1), Reinforced Shield (2) and Divine Shield (3): 12 in all.

items.name: Golden Skull
items.howTo: Rarely from Bokoblins (whip it off one that carries it), in some chests, from the Clean Cut minigame on Bamboo Island, or from the Moonlight Merchant.
items.notes: Used in Quick Beetle (1), Large Bomb Bag (1), Large Quiver (1) and Large Seed Satchel (1): 4 in all.

items.name: Eldin Ore
items.howTo: Dig it up from soft-soil spots on Eldin Volcano with the Digging Mitts.
items.notes: Used in Iron Bow (2), Reinforced Shield (2) and Fortified Shield (3): 7 in all.

items.name: Lizard Tail
items.howTo: Dropped by Lizalfos, first met in the Earth Temple.
items.notes: Used in Sacred Bow (3), Medium Bomb Bag (1) and Large Bomb Bag (3): 7 in all.

items.name: Tumbleweed
items.howTo: Catch one rolling across Lanayru Desert with the Bug Net.
items.notes: Used in Iron Bow (3), Sacred Bow (5), Big Bug Net (3), Braced Shield (2) and Fortified Shield (3): 16 in all.

items.name: Ancient Flower
items.howTo: Only blooms around an active Timeshift Stone, in Lanayru Desert, the Sand Sea and the Pirate Stronghold.
items.notes: Used in Quick Beetle (2), Tough Beetle (3) and Big Bug Net (2): 7 in all.

items.name: Dusk Relic
items.howTo: Only in the Silent Realms, including replays in Lanayru's Lightning Round, or from the Moonlight Merchant.
items.notes: Used in Scattershot (2), Medium Quiver (3), Large Quiver (3), Divine Shield (1) and Goddess Shield (4): 13 in all.

items.name: Evil Crystal
items.howTo: Dropped by Cursed Bokoblins and Dark Keese; also in some chests, from Clean Cut and from the Moonlight Merchant.
items.notes: Used in Iron Bow (1), Sacred Bow (2) and Big Bug Net (1): 4 in all.

items.name: Monster Horn
items.howTo: Whip the horn from a Bokoblin leader before he blows it; also in some chests and from the Moonlight Merchant.
items.notes: Used in Medium Quiver (3), Large Quiver (2) and Goddess Shield (3): 8 in all.

items.name: Goddess Plume
items.howTo: Rare: in some chests, sometimes in place of an Amber or Dusk Relic, from Thrill Digger and Clean Cut, or from the Moonlight Merchant.
items.notes: Used in Tough Beetle (1), Sacred Bow (1) and Large Quiver (1): 3 in all.
